abstract.t: This document defines the AAuth authorization protocol for agent-to- resource authorization and identity claim retrieval. The protocol supports five resource access modes — agent identity, resource- managed (two-party), person identity, PS authorization (three-party), and federated authorization (four-party) — with agent governance as an orthogonal layer. It builds on the HTTP Signature Keys specification ([I-D.hardt-httpbis-signature-key]) for HTTP Message Signatures and key discovery.
